maddeler.e:
نجتمر (form VIII)
# نَجْتَمِرُ (najtamiru) /nad͡ʒ.ta.mi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَمَرَ (ijtamara)
# نَجْتَمِرَ (najtamira) /nad͡ʒ.ta.mi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَمَرَ (ijtamara)
# نَجْتَمِرْ (najtamir) /nad͡ʒ.ta.mir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِجْتَمَرَ (ijtamara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
